actual_summary.scope: Passive complete saved-file joins and literal word-dictionary display decoding; no scientific Source execution/replay. Aggregate observation counts include any explicitly NONADMITTED failed attempts; separate admitted counts follow.

assessment: All four point arms share one general branch preference: novel hinted formulas, novel ordinary formulas, repeated hinted formulas, repeated ordinary formulas. Ordering is stable inside each tier. Forced choices, the Graph-selected point, every original alternative and exact rollback remain unchanged. No hint becomes a proof rule.

The admitted negative job supplies four local point packets. Each expands one primitive modus-ponens command and its guard, with actual earlier-row receptors. Both members later coexist before backtracking, growing the primitive prefix from four to five or six to seven rows. These are two local mathematical steps repeated across two arms, not four theorems.

Earlier D12 point calls supplied no packets. This cohort shows that the new shared point order can reach actual contexts where hints activate and their primitive members are selected. It does not isolate a useful causal advantage from cluster guidance: the primitive controls receive the same novelty heuristic, all point searches remain UNKNOWN, and only one whole job qualifies.

Two positive jobs exceed the unchanged whole-job memory ceiling. Their 14-row S0/SC checker-accepted observations are diagnostic only. Earlier D12 qualified certificates remain unchanged, and cannot rescue this cohort. The three-case admitted comparison is incomplete.

There are eighteen observed searches, 293 point placements, twenty-four audits and 144 word controls. Only the negative job qualifies: six searches, 86 placements, eight audits and 48 controls. No admitted recipient certificate is produced in this cohort.

Whole memory includes worker, waited Native, custodian, observer and declared reserves. First/equality parent bounds individually pass, but their complete observer-plus-reserve totals exceed one GiB. Existing high-water readings do not identify the causal allocation phase; no memory phase profile was measured.

Ground registry queries remain Native UNKNOWN, unadmitted and usable empty. Actual-context Host-checked primitive preferences are separate from registered inference blocks. No trained RL, new pruning rule, physical universal Wang bridge or broadly useful proof-search gain is established.

The next step should address bounded memory ownership with unchanged logical semantics and resource gates, then repeat a separately reviewed matched cohort. A change needs fresh Sources, reviews and one-use plans. Current failed jobs will remain failed; no rerun or memory-limit relaxation is included here.

The full program remains practical boundary tiling, hierarchical receptor and lemma families, learned proposal policies, automated arithmetic and symbolic Hilbert geometry, and honest conventional benchmarks. Turtle/Penrose plane constructions and the universal Wang bridge remain unfinished.

interpretation.cluster_value: Each successful extension here consists of one MP command plus its guard; the instantiation and other premise lines already existed in the actual prefix. Reuse is real at the ordering level, but no multi-step compression, learned new inference rule, target completion or RL benefit was established.
interpretation.fairness: P01/P11 duplicated the same two qualified local conclusions; these are four actual packets but only two distinct local MP applications. Memory and search clocks are unchanged; differences in total placement counts within a two-second window cannot establish speed or solve-rate improvement.
interpretation.funnel: Completed-call classifications are passive literal premises/conclusion joins, not new executed rejection counters. In these catalogs assumption commands are a leading block; an unsaturated first missing receptor implies an early return by pinned _expand Source. Equality zero packets is consistent with absent later receptors/saturation in its completed calls; no claim about interrupted scans or checker-time costs.
interpretation.novelty: Every recorded branch order is exactly the stable four-bin permutation of original candidates using the actual paired-prefix formulas and saved preferred membership. Every recorded forced order is unchanged. This validates recorded order conformance, not an independent replay of global graph completeness or legal states; those depend on actual saved audit receipts and prior Source review.
interpretation.observed: Common novelty changes the recorded point paths from repeated formulas to diverse actual paired prefixes. Four qualified negative local MP packets and four diagnostic first-positive packets were returned and activated. All eight packets completed their nominated two primitive members before member backtracking; see per-packet trace joins. No point target proof was found.
interpretation.resource: The two positive D13 jobs fail the whole bound. Their symbolic accepted proofs, local point extensions and other scientific observations remain diagnostic. D12 positive proof certificates keep their own separate qualification. The negative D13 job is resource-admitted; its search UNKNOWN does not prove non-derivability.
